title: Add invocation-phase breakdown telemetry, noisefloor alert gating, and quantile-smoothing aggregator
author: Sophie Chen
release_notes: Introduces per-invocation phase timing metrics, a quantile-smoothing aggregator for more stable pXX signals, and an alert noise-floor gating mechanism. Backwards-compatible metric names; dashboards and alerts updated.
description: Motivation: Long-tail and bursty invocation behavior is creating noisy SLO alerting and making it hard to attribute cost/latency to specific phases of the serving pipeline. This PR introduces three pieces: 1) per-invocation-phase timing metrics (prefix-warmup, tokenize, kv-lookup, model-exec, stream-flush) exposed as a compact histogram and phase label so we can build waterfall visualizations and attribute token-level latency/cost; 2) a quantile-smoothing aggregator that computes smoothed p50/p90/p95 over rolling windows using a lightweight reservoir + EWMA-like dampening to avoid reaction to single short spikes; 3) an alert noise-floor gating rule that suppresses alerts until exceedance is above an adaptive baseline for a configurable duration (reduces noisy alerts from small, transient bursts). The description below is a single narrative with implementation notes, checklist, and links. Implementation notes: - Runtime: instrumented the serving runtime (server/invocation/phases) to emit a new metric invocation_phase_latency_seconds_bucket with label phase and invocation_id for sampling. We kept the existing invocation_duration_seconds metric for compatibility. Added lightweight per-request phase timers and a PhaseTimer class with microbenchmark-optimized hot path. - Telemetry pipeline: added a new ingestion stage quantile_smoother in telemetry/aggregator that subscribes to phase histograms and produces smoothed pXX recording rules. The aggregator runs in a sharded fashion keyed by tenant+route to bound cardinality. - Prometheus/Recording: added recording rules that generate invocation_phase_p50/p90/p95_smoothed{phase,tenant,route}. Rules are best-effort and will fallback to raw percentiles when aggregator is unavailable. - Dashboards: added grafana dashboards under grafana/dashboards/invocation_phase_v2.json with waterfall panels, stacked phase histograms, and a compact cost/vs-latency quadrant for identifying expensive tokens. - Alerts: replaced a handful of noisy per-route p95 alert rules with gated versions that require exceedance above noisefloor (a percentile-derived baseline per-route) for at least 3m, plus a derivative check on the smoothed p90 to capture sustained degradations. - Tests: unit tests for PhaseTimer, integration tests for quantile_smoother ingest semantics, and an e2e dashboard generation smoke test. Compatibility and safety: metric names are additive and labeled to avoid exploding cardinality; we capped per-invocation labels in ingestion and rely on sampled invocation_id only in traces. Rollout plan: start with 10% of tenants on canary sampling of phase metrics, monitor SLO/reduction in alert noise, expand to 100% after 48h of canary. Checklist: - [x] runtime phase timers and histogram emission - [x] quantile_smoother service and unit tests - [x] recording rules and prometheus config - [x] grafana dashboard and dashboard smoke test - [x] alert gating rule and updated runbook links - [x] e2e test in CI - [x] docs: observability/phase-metrics.md with example queries Links: Linear tickets ENG-4219, ENG-4301; runbook reference: docs/runbooks/slo-alerts.md; dashboard preview: grafana/preview/invocation_phase_v2.png

merge_outcome: Merged via squash on 2026-02-17 by Maya Patel after approvals from Riley Park and Jonah Ruiz. Commit message consolidated. Changelog entry added.
notes_for_ops: Staged rollout: enable phase metrics for canary tenants using feature flag telemetry.phase_metrics=canary. Quantile smoother runs as 3 replicas; tune sharding via telemetry.smoother.shards. If smoother falls back, recording rules use raw percentiles and alerts remain conservative. Runbook updated with steps to force alerts and to disable gating per-tenant.
observability_impact_summary: Expected: 60-75% reduction in noisy p95 alerts on routes tested during canary; improved attribution for 95th-99th tail across phases. Cost impact: marginal extra ingestion (~5-8%) during canary because phase histograms are sampled; smoothing reduces alert churn which lowers paging costs.
backcompat_notes: All metric names additive. Existing dashboards and alerts using invocation_duration_seconds remain functional. New labels are sharded and we avoid high-cardinality combinations by limiting label sets and sampling invocation ids.
security_considerations: No sensitive data emitted. Invocation ids are sampled and only full ids emitted when debug_mode enabled (enterprise opt-in). Quantile smoother runs in telemetry VPC and follows existing KMS encryption for at-rest snapshots.
